name: IAT Automobile Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in Beijing, China, in 2007, IAT Automobile Technology Co., Ltd. is a global player specializing in comprehensive automotive development, from initial design and prototyping to component manufacturing, assembly, and rigorous testing. The company operates both within China and internationally. IAT provides a broad spectrum of services for traditional internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles. These include extensive vehicle research, sophisticated design and engineering (incorporating computer-aided engineering and NVH analysis), and powertrain development. The company also handles the creation of prototype hardware, tools, and fixtures, alongside expertise in automotive electrical and electronic systems development and consulting. Their capabilities extend to crafting show cars, race cars, and customized vehicles, coupled with technical consulting. Further offerings encompass thorough road testing, assembly, and parts validation, technical advisory, market analysis, product planning, and the implementation of simultaneous engineering principles. Beyond conventional automobiles, IAT is a key contributor to the electric vehicle (EV) sector. They offer end-to-end EV solutions, spanning design, research and development, performance optimization, and integrated powertrain system design. Specific EV expertise includes the development of EV controllers, motor and battery matching, and innovative research into battery quick-change technologies. Additionally, the company is proficient in automotive architecture design, software development, and thorough testing procedures across all its domains.
